proposed_from.topic: K1 Define a triangular class for scalar bounded causal features and K<K_n with unique interior quantizers, controlled curvature and margin, nuisance rate r_n, adjacent score variance sigma_{P,K}^2=Var(phi_{rho,K+1}-phi_{rho,K}), and minimum standardized gap min_K [rho(K+1)-rho(K)]/sigma_{P,K}. K2 derive the maximal joint growth region for K_n, standardized gap, curvature, margin, and r_n that permits simultaneous bands and locally honest set-valued profiles, plus the complementary failure boundary. K3 construct a corrected-moment growing-class bootstrap attaining it. K4 prove a matching adjacent-quantization lower bound. Use U uniform on [0,1] and MineThatData as witness and consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: For the uniform law, W(K)=1/(12K^2), rho(K)=1-K^{-2}, fixed-K loss variance is 1/(180K^4), adjacent score deviation is plausibly order K^{-2}, and the standardized gap is therefore order K^{-1}, refuting the raw-gap n^{1/6} heuristic. Cell-center estimation contributes excess risk near 1/(nK), so codebook estimation, nuisance error, and Gaussian approximation determine the frontier. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove uniform codebook stability and bootstrap approximation while tracking standardized gap, margin, and causal-feature remainder. EARLY KILL TEST: Compute adjacent score variance exactly for growing K under the uniform law; pivot if cancellation changes its order or corrected-moment remainder becomes first-order well below the conjectured range.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest causal result is fixed-resolution and the closest quantization lower bound concerns fixed-resolution excess distortion. The proposed theorem instead identifies an exact cross-resolution covariance kernel, proves a diverging intrinsic packing, and forces over \(\mathcal U_n\) the same Gaussian-width radius by an observed-data multi-resolution Fano family while maintaining causal identification and quantizer stability.

seed_details.anchor: KimKimKennedy2026, Lemma 4.1 and Web Appendix proof of the efficient influence function; Introduction and Discussion
seed_details.opportunity: Derive the exact adjacent efficient-score variance and its observation-noise phase transition before attempting any growing-resolution band.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The fixed-\(K\) score is available, but subtracting neighboring optimized scores introduces cancellation in the geometric term and a different residual-noise order.
seed_details.first_changed_step: Subtract the two efficient influence functions before applying the central limit theorem and integrate the resulting projection difference over the uniform quantizer cells.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches for causal \(k\)-means adjacent efficient-score variance, growing quantization central limit theory, and studentized shrinking-variance bootstrap found no occupied target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from KimKimKennedy2026 because influence functions are linear; rebuttal: linear subtraction does not reveal that causal residual noise changes variance from \(K^{-4}\) to \(K^{-2}\), and the exact finite-\(K\) constants are absent.

seed_details.anchor: BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018, Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.2; Introduction and multiplier-band construction
seed_details.opportunity: Give an explicit sufficient frontier for simultaneous corrected-score bands when each coordinate reoptimizes a moving codebook and has shrinking variance.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The supplied-score Bahadur representation must be replaced by a \(K\)-uniform optimized-risk expansion with curvature and margin constants retained.
seed_details.first_changed_step: Before Gaussian approximation, prove the standardized Bahadur remainder bound represented by \(\Gamma_n\).
seed_details.target_method_search: The scan found many-parameter orthogonal bands and fixed-level causal quantization, but no growing optimized causal-distortion profile.
seed_details.red_team: A routine application of high-dimensional bootstrap; rebuttal: the score class is data-dependent through \(K_n\) separate nonsmooth optimizers, and its raw variances vanish at a geometry- and noise-dependent rate.

seed_details.proof_boundary: Levrard's separated-source family changes global fixed-\(k\) distortion; it does not generate contiguous adjacent-gain alternatives inside an observed-data causal experiment.

seed_details.target_method_search: Adjacent quantization testing, causal efficient-score packing, and honest profile undercoverage were not found in the quantization or causal-clustering literature.
seed_details.red_team: Levrard2015 already has the minimax lower bound; rebuttal: its loss is fixed-level excess codebook risk, whereas this seed concerns local discrimination of neighboring optimized causal resolutions and simultaneous undercoverage.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The M17 lane has a named obstruction: treatment permutation is exact only under a sharp null and cannot identify the missing conditional feature profile.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected kernel sits at the unoccupied intersection of four threads. KimKimKennedy2026 gives the fixed-resolution efficient causal-quantization score and a corrected estimator, but its proofs absorb \(K\) into constants. Levrard2015 and Pollard1982Central control fixed-level optimizer geometry through margin, separation, and positive curvature; LiuPages2020 tracks changing quantizers but not causal scores or simultaneous inference. BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018 and ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2017HighDimensional give orthogonal-score bands and rectangle bootstrap tools after a uniform Bahadur representation, while ChernozhukovChetverikovKoike2021NearlyOptimal sharpens the nondegenerate-covariance approximation. AndrewsSoares2010 and ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2019MMI supply local moment-selection logic, not moving optimized moments. Searches through September 1, 2026 found no paper deriving adjacent causal-quantization score variances, a growing-\(K\) causal resolution band, or a geometry-preserving adjacent-gain converse.
